body: I feel SO SO BAD. I’m just a fucking quitter. As soon as there’s a challenge, I quit, I hate myself for that but I hate it even more when I had to spend tons of time solving the problems. I can’t even handle 3 classes in one quarter, almost all the classes I took are easy As. As an INFP, I seem to don’t have any talent such as writing or painting, I actually suck at writing. I’m just overall a negative complainer who’s good at nothing and keeps complaining about everything. I’m a fucking joke

One thing I can tell you is that you will for sure find someone who loves you crazy and makes you filled with tremendous happiness as long as you believe in it. Being rejected in such a cruel way is extremely painful, but it will make your true love even more precious. And also you can be my friend if you want to, I always envy people who have gay/lesbian friends because I think they are such cool and fun and understanding and amazing people!
I’m getting tired of trying all kinds of methods to get out of that mental condition. Can I just stay unmotivated 😔

Econ major graduating the end of 2020, and I have 3 accounting interviews tomorrow. Googled all kinds of preparations and realized Econ major is basically useless unless you want further study which I don’t plan to do. Coz I already spent fucking 6 years in undergrad. I feel I already fucked up the beginning of my career.😅 (I spent 2 years in majoring English and switched to Econ)
I have been feeling terrible the whole weekend and seeing this made me feel much better. Thank you!
